name: Bacon;Long
source:
A yuri visual novel about two scientists, a crispy piece of Bacon and the fate of our timeline as we know it.

Shirogane Dai is a world-renowned Bacon connoisseur and mad scientist, who after stumbling upon the very pinnacle of bacon perfection, suddenly finds herself in the centre of a battle between a mysterious scientist and the shadowy Leftover Corporation with the fate of the timeline itself hanging in the balance.

Can our eccentric genius and her new mysterious ally set aside their differences and work together to save the world? Will Dai succeed, or will the Leftovers be free to enact their will across time and space?

[From [url=https://abdulgoodlooks.itch.io/baconlong]itch.io[/url]]

Based of Bacon;Long, a playable fan-fiction Discord joke.
